rationale: Species-specific Adelie exclude-unknown recovery is below the frozen species-specific threshold (86/100), while the paper-level V4 estimand is the cross-species median gamma_AH. Robustness of the primary paper claim must therefore be tested directly without erasing the Adelie-specific limitation.

exclude_unknown.statistic: median of the three species-specific V3 gamma_AH estimates in each replicate
exclude_unknown.species_specific_reporting: Adelie 86/100 V3 sign recovery remains disclosed even if the cross-species statistic passes.

ground_only.statistic: mean/median of CHPE and GEPE gamma_AH estimates

simulation.observation_calibration: full synthetic 2100-record layout; source filter applies only to demographic reconstruction

unlock_rule: Paper-level source robustness passes only if both exclude-unknown cross-species and ground-only CHPE/GEPE gates pass. This does not convert the Adelie species-specific sensitivity into a pass.
boundary: No threshold is relaxed from V4/V3.
No real count magnitude is opened.
No favorable species subset is selected in exclude-unknown mode.
Universal wording remains prohibited if any species-specific robustness is limited.
